metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 19 healthy subjects using a 16-channel g.tec g.USBamp amplifier with wet electrodes in a standard 10-10 montage, sampled at 512 Hz with right earlobe reference. Subjects performed alternating eyes-closed and eyes-open resting-state conditions, each lasting 10 seconds. Data were recorded using OpenViBE software with 50 Hz line frequency and no online digital filtering applied.
